BiblicalUsage: Hagab is named once, among the Nethinim who returned — the children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan. He is one of the temple servants whose families came home from exile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Nethinim are the proof that no servant in God's house is forgotten, even when his name appears once.
